title: 珍珠奶茶的故事
summary: Who invented it, what the pearls are, and how to order.
paragraphs: 珍珠奶茶是臺灣最有名的飲料之一，現在在世界各地都買得到。
關於珍奶是誰發明的，有兩種不同的說法：一家店在臺中，一家店在臺南，雙方還曾經為了這件事打過官司。
珍珠是用樹薯粉做的，吃起來QQ的，很有嚼勁。
在臺灣點飲料的時候，店員通常會問你甜度和冰塊，例如「半糖少冰」或「無糖去冰」。
有些人擔心喝太多含糖飲料對身體不好，所以越來越多人選擇微糖或無糖。
不管怎麼樣，珍奶已經成為代表臺灣的文化符號。
translation: Bubble milk tea is one of Taiwan's most famous drinks, and now you can buy it all over the world.
There are two stories about who invented it: one shop in Taichung and one in Tainan. The two even went to court over it.
The pearls are made from tapioca starch; they are bouncy and chewy.
When you order a drink in Taiwan, the clerk usually asks about sweetness and ice, such as "half sugar, less ice" or "no sugar, no ice".
Some people worry that too many sugary drinks are bad for their health, so more and more people choose light sugar or none.
Either way, bubble tea has become a cultural symbol of Taiwan.

glossary.官司: lawsuit (打官司 to go to court)
